description: This file is a test script for Git's pack-objects command, specifically testing the --include-tag feature. It sets up various repository states, creates tags, packs objects with and without including tags, unpacks and verifies objects, and tests behavior with annotated tags and nested tags.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Setup commands to initialize a Git repository, create commits, and tags used for testing.

methods.name: pack without --include-tag
methods.description: Create a pack of objects without including tags.

methods.name: unpack objects
methods.description: Unpack the generated pack file into a new repository clone.

methods.name: check unpacked result (have commit, no tag)
methods.description: Verify that only commit objects are present after unpacking, and the tag object is missing.

methods.name: pack with --include-tag
methods.description: Create a pack including tags using the --include-tag option.

methods.name: check unpacked result (have commit, have tag)
methods.description: Verify that both commit and tag objects are present after unpacking with --include-tag.

methods.name: create hidden inner tag
methods.description: Create nested tags including a tag of a tag, then delete an inner tag to test visibility.

methods.name: pack explicit outer tag
methods.description: Create a pack including specific tags, using explicit references.

methods.name: check unpacked result (have all objects)
methods.description: Verify that all objects related to certain tags are presentes after unpacking.

methods.name: pack implied outer tag
methods.description: Create a pack that implies including a tag without explicitly referencing it, using --include-tag.

methods.name: single-branch clone can transfer tag
methods.description: Clone a repository and verify tags are transferred correctly.
